syllabus_extract: Types of fibers. Properties and uses of Glass fibers, Carbon fibers, Ceramics fibers, Boron fibers and Aramid fibers.
specific_objectives: 17.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the development of composite materials, types and functions of fibers and resin, Defects in composite, selection criteria for Matrix, fabric weaves, prepress, strength flowcharts

intro_questions: What is the primary function of the fiber in a composite material?
Name one common matrix material used in composites.
Why are fibers essential for structural strength in aerospace applications?
